question: What Are the 3 Types of Photoelectric Sensors?
body_html:
Photoelectric sensor types are through beam, retro reflective and diffuse reflective, classified by how the emitter light reaches the receiver.

TypeHow It WorksKey Point
Through beamSeparate emitter and receiver face each other; the object blocks the beamLongest range, needs careful alignment
Retro reflectiveEmitter and receiver in one housing, light returns from a reflectorWiring at one location, struggles with mirror surfaces
Diffuse reflectiveThe object itself reflects light back to the receiverEasy to mount, affected by color and texture
